title: Cancel job
intro: Review the contract and the records affected before cancelling.

source.acceptance: Project Backlog row 29; Sprint Backlog III rows 47–48

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 29; Sprint Backlog III rows 47–48
criteria.requirement: Allow the owning creator to cancel Pending, Accepted or In Progress jobs only when no payment is Paid.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 29; Sprint Backlog III rows 47–48
criteria.requirement: Confirmed cancellation sets Cancelled, closes active job requests and rejects remaining Pending offers.

criteria.source: Project Backlog row 29; Sprint Backlog III rows 47–48
criteria.requirement: Reject cancellation for Completed or Paid jobs, keep terminal states read-only and recover unknown outcomes with a read.

scenarios.title: Pending job
scenarios.expected: Cancellation is available to the creator.

scenarios.title: Accepted job
scenarios.expected: Show current contract details and an explicit cancel action.

scenarios.title: In Progress job
scenarios.trigger: Open an In Progress unpaid job.
scenarios.expected: Allow cancellation with its consequences explained.

scenarios.title: Cancellation confirmation
scenarios.expected: Show job identity and effects; Keep job closes the dialog without changes.

scenarios.title: Cancellation pending
scenarios.expected: Submit once. Permit Close, Escape, outside dismissal and Continue browsing while preserving the operation and View progress. A 12-second deadline or document return becomes unknown/check state with no automatic resubmission.

scenarios.title: Cancellation confirmed
scenarios.expected: Show Cancelled, zero active requests and zero Pending offers; remove cancellation.

scenarios.title: Paid job
scenarios.expected: Explain why cancellation is unavailable and do not enable cancellation.

scenarios.title: Completed job
scenarios.expected: Preserve payment and review history; do not allow cancellation.

scenarios.title: Already Cancelled
scenarios.expected: Keep cancellation read-only and do not resubmit.

scenarios.title: Unverified state
scenarios.trigger: The current state is not recognized.
scenarios.expected: Do not guess eligibility; offer a fresh read.

scenarios.title: Unknown cancellation outcome
scenarios.expected: Check current job state before a new cancellation.

scenarios.title: Cancellation rejected
scenarios.trigger: Receive a rejection without a state change.
scenarios.expected: Keep the current contract and offer refresh.

scenarios.title: Access removed
scenarios.expected: Remove private contract data and mutation controls.

scenarios.title: Job read failed
scenarios.expected: Show failure rather than an empty or cancellable job.

scenarios.title: Job loading
scenarios.expected: Prevent cancellation while eligibility is unknown.

presentationDecisions.precedence: Current human UX/UI guidance supersedes older presentation defaults; domain prerequisites remain unchanged.
presentationDecisions.loading: Close presentation without claiming rollback; keep background result/reopen affordance, 12-second unknown/read recovery and a same-tab fictional operation journal. Never replay a write on return.
presentationDecisions.pagination: Omit Previous entirely on the first page and Next on the last page.
presentationDecisions.copy: Keep only meaningful consequences, validation, uncertainty and next steps; do not repeat a visible status.
